units.source_text: 不论是想回避春游岚山的游客，还是想去仇野和野野宫，这些都不应是一个年轻姑娘所想的。

en.t: Whether she wanted to avoid the tourists visiting Arashiyama in spring, or wanted to go to Adashino and Nonomiya, none of these were things a young girl ought to be thinking about.

units.source_text: 这比穿父亲所画的朴素图案的衣裳还要……

en.t: This was even more than wearing clothes with the simple patterns her father had drawn...
